name: Fisher of Hidden Depths
desc:
An Abyssal creature that slips through rifts in the hidden depths, crossing over from beyond this world.
Long ago, an ancient philosopher described humans as "featherless bipeds," using that simple phrase to distinguish mankind from animals and assert human superiority. In some sense, these deathless wanderers of the silent cosmic void, scaled instead of feathered, and using their hooked beaks to draw in biomass from world to world, might actually also match that same simplistic definition of "human."

customize.text: A swarm of monsters that surged through the Rift of Hidden Depths. When several Fishers of Hidden Depths are present on-field, their connections to one another will form Deepdark Shield(s). The shield(s) can only be broken by Elemental Attacks or reaction DMG. <color=#ffe14b>Lunar Reaction DMG</color> is especially effective at breaking the shield(s).

When the Deepdark Shield of one of the Fisher of Hidden Depths is broken, the monsters' shared connection causes all Deepdark Shields within the swarm to shatter. The entire swarm will then be grouped around the Fisher whose shield was broken.

dropMaterial.name: Mora
dropMaterial.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

dropMaterial.name: Fractured Eye of the Deep Shadow
dropMaterial.desc:
The remains of a fisher from beyond this world, left after its body dissolved.
Once its shell cracked, the malice housed within faded away as well.

dropMaterial.name: Aberrant Core of the Deep Shadow
dropMaterial.desc:
The remains of a fisher from beyond this world, left after its body dissolved.
A core whose functions have fully shut down, and its structure resembles no organ of any creature found on this earth.

dropMaterial.name: Hooked Beak of the Deep Shadow
dropMaterial.desc:
The remains of a fisher from beyond this world, left after its body dissolved.
A birdlike, hook-shaped beak used by predators from beyond this world to store the biomass they seize.
